not_met.lacks: The document says the main conversation makes and judges nothing of a deliverable, never reads the design tree itself, and never writes the tree, since only the planner changes it, at rn/architecture.md:47, rn/architecture.md:88, and rn/architecture.md:105. It also says that Lane holds none of the main conversation's calls besides its starts of roles, its stops, and its calls of /rn:up, at rn/architecture.md:287-289 and rn/architecture.md:97-98. So no unit or architecture test can show that these three hold. The list of what the product vision trial checks first names only the main conversation's choice of whose a point is and how it's settled, at rn/architecture.md:944-945, and a trial passes on its steps and its stand-ins' uses, at rn/architecture.md:1013-1021. When the unit and architecture tests pass, the developer doesn't know whether the main conversation keeps off the tree and the deliverables. They also can't count on the product vision level to confirm it, as the trial isn't named as its first check and has nothing that looks for it.
